item.title: Refactor order status String into OrderStatus enum (orders crate)
item.brief:
The `orders` crate stores an order's status as a `String` and compares string literals all over the code. Refactor it to a proper type. This is a behaviour-preserving refactor: observable behaviour (errors, report output and ordering, parsing) must stay exactly the same, and `cargo test` must pass.

Requirements:
- Add `src/status.rs` with `pub enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }` deriving at least `Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash`.
- `OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str` returns the lowercase names ("pending", "paid", "shipped", "cancelled"); `Display` prints the same.
- `FromStr` for `OrderStatus` with `type Err = ParseStatusError`, a public error type that implements `std::error::Error` and whose message names the rejected input.
- `OrderStatus::can_transition_to(self, next: OrderStatus) -> bool` encodes the lifecycle: pending -> paid, pending -> cancelled, paid -> shipped, paid -> cancelled; nothing else.
- `Order::status` becomes an `OrderStatus`; re-export `OrderStatus` and `ParseStatusError` from the crate root; use the enum everywhere, so the status string literals appear only in `src/status.rs`.

Acceptance: the existing behaviour is preserved (compare the report output and ordering before and after), `cargo test` passes, and the work is committed on the item's branch. Do not add a PR; this repository ships local.

Constraints: follow the repository's style; keep functions under 60 lines; add no unnecessary comments; do not change observable output.

stages.summary:
Baseline and characterization for "Refactor order status String into OrderStatus enum (orders crate)". No production code changed.

Commits (branch archon/j1qj52w5-refactor-order-status-string-into-orders, not pushed):
- Original baseline: 50298f327975baf602c42acf71d11befac4e8610 (tree 6e35d20143ea2a04a1a2774dbb91a210c78ccdcf)
- Characterization: 62f17ea08a0e15757cc770694c28efa3c10e89b2 "test: characterize order status lifecycle, reports and parsing" (tree 765df52b46eedefcda57cf750d2ef27299d4e839). Adds tests/characterization.rs only.

Structural goal (from brief): Order.status String -> OrderStatus enum {Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled} in new src/status.rs, with as_str/Display, FromStr (Err = ParseStatusError), can_transition_to (pending->paid, pending->cancelled, paid->shipped, paid->cancelled), re-exports at crate root, and status literals only in status.rs. Brief-allowed contract change: Order.status type. Current code's transition rules already match the brief's table.

Checks, before adding tests (at 50298f3):
- `cargo test`: exit 0, 3 passed (tests/orders.rs), 0 doctests.
- `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`: exit 0, clean.
- `cargo fmt --check`: exit 1. Pre-existing, not from this work: diffs in src/billing.rs, src/order.rs, src/report.rs (2 hunks), src/shipping.rs, tests/orders.rs. Left unfixed to keep scope.
Checks after adding tests (at 62f17ea):
- `cargo test`: exit 0, 15 passed in tests/characterization.rs, 3 passed in tests/orders.rs.
- clippy: exit 0. rustfmt --check on tests/characterization.rs: exit 0. Repo-wide fmt drift unchanged.
Toolchain: cargo/rustc 1.98.1. No README, CONTRIBUTING, Makefile or CI config exists; the commands above are the only checks available. Build cache: the item's CARGO_TARGET_DIR.

Public surface to preserve (inventory):
- Order { pub id: u32, pub customer: String, pub total_cents: u64, pub status: <String -> OrderStatus> }, derives Debug, Clone, PartialEq; Order::new(id, &str, u64) starts "pending"; Order::is_open (pending or paid); Order::cancel -> Result<(), String>.
- billing::pay(&mut Order) -> Result<(), String>; billing::outstanding_cents(&[Order]) -> u64 (pending only).
- shipping::ship(&mut Order) -> Result<(), String>; shipping::ready_to_ship(&[Order]) -> Vec<u32> (paid only, input order).
- report::status_counts(&[Order]) -> Vec<(String, usize)>: ordered by name, alphabetically (cancelled, paid, pending, shipped), NOT lifecycle order. Decision for refactorer: keep the String return type, or change it to OrderStatus only with an explicit Ord that matches name order. A derived Ord would follow variant order and change output.
- report::to_line(&Order) -> "id,customer,total_cents,status"; report::from_line(&str) -> Result<Order, String>.
- Exact error texts: "order {id} cannot be paid: it is {status}", "order {id} cannot be shipped: it is {status}", "order {id} cannot be cancelled: it is {status}", "expected 4 fields, got {n}", "bad id {:?}: {parse err}", "bad total {:?}: {parse err}", "unknown status {:?}" (the status field is Debug-quoted, so no trim). Check order in from_line: field count, then id, then total, then status.
- Allowed exception: the Order.status type (brief). Everything else must match byte for byte.

Characterization tests added (tests/characterization.rs, 15), all written type-agnostically (to_string() and whole-Order equality) so they should compile against both the String and enum forms:
- New orders start pending; to_line shows "pending".
- pay refused from paid/shipped/cancelled with exact text, Order unchanged on failure.
- ship refused from pending/shipped/cancelled with exact text, unchanged on failure.
- cancel succeeds from pending and paid; refused from shipped (exact text, unchanged) and cancelled (exact text, unchanged).
- is_open true only for pending and paid.
- outstanding_cents counts only pending; empty -> 0.
- ready_to_ship returns paid ids in input order; empty -> [].
- status_counts with all four statuses: [cancelled 1, paid 2, pending 1, shipped 1]; empty -> empty. Pins name ordering.
- to_line/from_line round-trip for each of the four statuses.
- from_line trims only the outer whitespace of the line: " paid" with a leading space is rejected as `unknown status " paid"`; customer kept verbatim.
- from_line rejects "lost", "Paid" (case-sensitive) and "" with exact texts.
- from_line field-count errors: "", 3 fields, 5 fields.
- from_line number errors: bad id, bad total, u32 overflow, negative total; id is checked before total before status.
The existing tests/orders.rs is untouched. Note: its reports_count_and_round_trip annotates counts as Vec<(String, usize)> after a to_string() map, so it still compiles if status_counts changes type.

Known gaps: no test of the status field's Debug output in errors (not a public contract); no test that from_line accepts or rejects inputs with embedded newlines beyond the outer trim; no test of Order's Debug format. The brief's can_transition_to table is not yet covered (it's new API). The refactorer should add its own tests for OrderStatus, FromStr, and ParseStatusError.

Feedback: none on this first attempt.

Nothing is running: no servers or processes were started, and the worktree is clean on the branch.

stages.summary:
Refactored Order.status from String to an OrderStatus enum in the orders crate. Two commits on archon/j1qj52w5-refactor-order-status-string-into-orders, not pushed, worktree clean. HEAD 9a64f41, tree 014634bd2b1ba4f107bca5bcb682ea234488a33e.

Commits: 57a3fc3 adds src/status.rs (OrderStatus with as_str, Display, FromStr, can_transition_to; ParseStatusError implements std::error::Error), re-exports both from the crate root, and adds tests/status.rs with 5 tests. 9a64f41 switches Order.status to OrderStatus and updates order.rs, billing.rs, shipping.rs and report.rs. Status literals now appear only in src/status.rs.

Behaviour preserved: error texts are unchanged; from_line keeps its check order (field count, id, total, status) and its message is byte-identical via ParseStatusError Display. status_counts keeps its Vec<(String, usize)> return type and name ordering. The 15 characterization tests and the 3 pre-existing tests are unchanged and pass.

Checks: cargo test passes (15 characterization, 3 orders, 5 status, 0 failures). cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings exits 0. rustfmt --check on touched files exits 0; repo-wide fmt drift remains in tests/orders.rs, which is untouched.

Left open: status_counts ordering is verified by the characterization test, not by a separate before/after diff of binary output. Public API break: callers treating Order.status as a String must use OrderStatus, which the brief permits. Rated high risk.

checks: rustfmt --check --edition 2021 src/report.rs src/order.rs src/billing.rs src/shipping.rs src/status.rs tests/status.rs

evidence.none: Pure refactor with no observable output change; behaviour is pinned by the unchanged characterization and orders tests.

pr.body: Approach: new src/status.rs holds OrderStatus, ParseStatusError and the lifecycle rule can_transition_to. Order.status is OrderStatus. pay, ship and cancel guard with can_transition_to; is_open, outstanding_cents and ready_to_ship compare variants. report::from_line uses FromStr with ParseStatusError Display, which keeps the unknown status message byte-identical. report::status_counts keeps its String return type and name ordering via BTreeMap keyed by as_str; a derived Ord would change output order. Key files: src/status.rs, src/order.rs, src/billing.rs, src/shipping.rs, src/report.rs, src/lib.rs, tests/status.rs. Checks: cargo test passes, including the unchanged characterization and orders tests; clippy with -D warnings exits 0; rustfmt --check on touched files exits 0. Assumptions: the Order.status type change is the only permitted contract change. Limits: tests/orders.rs has pre-existing fmt drift, left untouched.
pr.summary: made order status a typed enum. now: OrderStatus with as_str, Display, FromStr and can_transition_to; status literals only in src/status.rs. before: Order.status String compared to literals; now: OrderStatus, behaviour unchanged.
pr.title: refactor: replace order status String with OrderStatus enum

risk.why: Public API break: Order.status changes type, so downstream callers must migrate. Touches five source files plus a new module. Behaviour is covered by the characterization tests, which pass unchanged.

Executed checks (CARGO_TARGET_DIR in the item cache):
- cargo test: exit 0. characterization 15/15, orders 3/3 (unchanged), status 5/5 (new), 0 doctests.
- cargo build: exit 0. cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings: exit 0 (re-run after touching src/lib.rs).
- cargo fmt --check: exit 1, with one diff at tests/orders.rs:40. That file is untouched and the drift is pre-existing. Baseline had drift in billing, order, report, shipping and tests/orders.rs; the four src files are now clean. rustfmt --check on the touched files: exit 0.
- Characterization tests run unchanged against the original baseline code (git archive 50298f3 in a throwaway copy): 15/15 pass.

- Public-surface probe: one binary built against baseline and HEAD. It covers all 4 states x pay/ship/cancel (result text, resulting status, is_open, to_line), status_counts/outstanding_cents/ready_to_ship on mixed, empty and single-status sets, and 47 from_line inputs (whitespace, CRLF, NUL, BOM, quotes, signs, u32/u64 overflow, empty and extra fields, case variants). The only output difference is the derived Debug of Order: status now prints as `Pending` instead of `"pending"`. This follows from the brief-allowed type change; non-blocking.
- Status literals in src/ appear only in src/status.rs. Brief items verified: derives, lowercase as_str and Display, FromStr with Err = ParseStatusError (std::error::Error, names the input), the exact four-edge can_transition_to table, root re-exports, and status_counts keeping Vec<(String, usize)> with name ordering.

Evidence: published artifact "verify-evidence" (out-base.txt, out-head.txt, probe-diff.txt, probe-main.rs, fmt-base.txt, fmt-head.txt). Throwaway probes removed. Nothing left running. Not done: no PR (not requested).

Findings: none blocking. Non-blocking notes: (1) the Order Debug format change at src/order.rs:4; (2) the fmt --check failure at tests/orders.rs:40, which is pre-existing.
